Where Precision Meets Purpose

A strong career in operations isn’t built by simply processing paperwork. It’s built by understanding how work moves through an organization, identifying where improvements can be made, and developing solutions that make the business more accurate, efficient, and effective.

At SAFCO, the Operations Analyst plays an important role in both the day-to-day management of vehicle titles and the continued improvement of processes throughout our Titles and Operations functions. This is an opportunity for a detail-oriented professional who is comfortable getting into the weeds of daily operations while also using analytical and technical skills to automate reporting, improve workflows, and support informed business decisions.

This is an in-office position located at our corporate headquarters in Pompano Beach, Florida. Candidates must currently live in the area or be willing to relocate.

Position Summary

The Operations Analyst is responsible for processing, tracking, and managing vehicle title documents for financed vehicles across multiple states. This includes ensuring accurate title recording and lien placement, maintaining title inventories, resolving discrepancies, and supporting the timely handling of documents.

In addition to these core responsibilities, the Operations Analyst will evaluate operational processes, develop reports and dashboards, and help identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and risk mitigation throughout the Titles and Operations Department.

Key Duties And Responsibilities

Receive repossessed-vehicle titles from tag offices and coordinate the submission of titles to the appropriate auctions.
Prepare check requests for payments to tag offices.
Ensure the accurate placement of liens and the timely release of liens following loan payoff.
Maintain accurate paper and electronic title inventories.
File and mail documents to auctions to support vehicle sales and title processing.
Review title statuses, investigate discrepancies, and proactively resolve issues.
Support the Loss Mitigation Department with title-related needs.
Assist with title audits and report reconciliation.
Analyze workflows to identify opportunities for process improvement and greater operational efficiency.
Build reports using SQL and Python to automate processes and reporting.
Create dashboards using data-visualization software to support operational decision-making.
Develop and present ideas to senior leadership regarding risk mitigation and operational precision.
Support the Finance Department with forecasting, modeling, and work involving our capital-markets partners and securitizations.
Communicate effectively with customers, dealers, and internal teams by telephone, email, and Microsoft Teams.

What You Bring To The Role

A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, Business Management, Accounting, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
Zero to two years of professional experience. Recent graduates looking to begin their careers are encouraged to apply.
A willingness to handle hands-on daily responsibilities, including manual processing and filing, while also driving operational excellence and workflow improvements.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
Strong analytical abilities and exceptional attention to detail.
SQL or Python experience is a plus.
Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish or English and Portuguese is preferred but not required.

Build Your Future With SAFCO

If you are ready to combine operational precision with analytical problem-solving, we invite you to apply. At SAFCO, your ideas will be heard, your work will have a meaningful impact, and you will have the opportunity to grow while helping improve the processes that move our business forward.

Position Summary

Pivot Apparel is seeking a detail-oriented and analytically driven Business Analyst to support our Global Planning and Strategy organization across all channels - Wholesale, Retail Stores, and E-Commerce. This role partners closely across the planning and merchandising ecosystem to turn large, complex data sets into clear, actionable recommendations that drive sales, inventory productivity, and margin across all categories - apparel and non-apparel. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience within a specialty contemporary apparel brand and is fluent in retail math, open-to-buy principles, and the cross-functional rhythm of a merchandising organization.
What You'll Do

•    
Partner with Merchandise Planning to build, maintain, and analyze seasonal sales, margin, and inventory plans at the department, class, and SKU level across all categories.

•    
Support Demand Forecasting by validating forecast accuracy, identifying trend shifts, and surfacing risks or opportunities in the sales forecast versus plan and versus prior year.
•    
Collaborate with Buying teams to analyze open-to-buy (OTB) positions, style/color productivity, and vendor performance, providing recommendations on receipt flow, chase opportunities, and markdown risk.
•    
Work with Allocation & Replenishment to evaluate weeks of supply (WOS), sell-through, and in-stock performance by door/DC and channel, recommending allocation strategy adjustments.
•    
Support Store Planning with door-level financial plans, cluster/segmentation analysis, and space or fixture productivity insights.
•    
Build and maintain reporting tools and dashboards (Excel-based and/or BI platforms) that synthesize large, multi-source data sets into digestible, decision-ready outputs for cross-functional partners.
•    
Conduct ad hoc analyses — such as 80/20 (Pareto) reviews, price elasticity, wholesale specialty account reconciliation, and style/color performance — to inform buy, allocation, and pricing decisions.
•    
Reconcile and validate data across multiple source systems (buy files, POS, financial plans, vendor files) to ensure a single source of truth for cross-functional decision-making.
•    
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations and action plans that non-analytical stakeholders can act on quickly.
•    
Act as a connective thread across Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising, Design, Marketing, Finance, Production, and Logistics — ensuring data, timelines, and decisions stay aligned across functions.
•    
Support seasonal calendar milestones (line sheet reviews, buy meetings, financial reconciliations, market prep) with timely, accurate analysis.
What You Bring

•    
2-3+ years of experience in a Business Analyst, Merchandise Planning, Buying, or Allocation role within a specialty contemporary apparel brand, with exposure to multiple categories.

•    
Strong command of retail math and understanding of nomenclature including inventory turn, seasonality, GMROI, cumulative sell-through, sell-through %, markdown %, and receipt flow planning.
•    Learned in Open-to-Buy interpretation and management.

•    
Demonstrated ability to work confidently with large, complex data sets — pulling, cleaning, reconciling, and synthesizing data from multiple sources into clear recommendations and action plans, not just reports.
•    
Advanced Excel skills required (pivot tables, complex formulas, SUMIFS/INDEX-MATCH, data modeling); experience with BI or planning tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or an OTB/allocation planning system) is a plus.
•    
Working knowledge of how Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising, Design, Marketing, Finance, Production, and Logistics collaborate across the seasonal calendar, and how decisions in one function ripple into the others.
•    
Strong business acumen paired with sharp attention to detail — comfortable moving between big-picture strategic recommendations and granular data validation.
•    
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present analysis and recommendations clearly to both analytical and non-analytical stakeholders.
•    
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines in a fast-paced, seasonal retail environment.
•    
Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, Merchandising, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications

•    
Experience supporting non-apparel or hardlines categories in addition to apparel.
•    
Familiarity with store planning concepts such as door clustering, space productivity, and fixture/adjacency planning.
•    
Exposure to demand forecasting or elasticity modeling, and an understanding of the operational factors (allocation, replenishment, buy depth) that can mask or influence price signals.
Why Join Pivot Apparel

You'll work at the intersection of data and product, helping shape how Pivot Apparel plans, buys, and delivers merchandise across all categories and channels. This role offers high visibility with senior Planning and Allocation leadership and the opportunity to directly influence buy strategy, inventory health, and store-level performance

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a highly organized, analytically driven Product Operations Analyst to support the day-to-day operational engine of our Private Markets product organization. This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of process, data, and collaboration — someone who takes genuine satisfaction in making complex teams run more smoothly, and who brings intellectual curiosity about private markets and a desire to grow into a broader product career. The ideal candidate is equal parts analyst and operator: comfortable pulling and interpreting product usage data one hour, and coordinating a cross-functional release readiness review the next. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and business stakeholders to ensure our product team operates with clarity, discipline, and pace. You are a clear communicator, a reliable executor, and a proactive problem-solver who treats operational gaps as opportunities rather than obstacles. This role is an outstanding entry point into private markets product management — you will gain broad exposure to the full product lifecycle, our platform architecture, and the investment workflows that underpin one of the fastest-growing segments of the asset management industry.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Product operations lead you will

Support the end-to-end operational cadence of the Private Markets product team — including sprint planning coordination, backlog grooming support, release tracking, and cross-functional dependency management.

Own and maintain product documentation infrastructure: PRD templates, release notes, feature wikis, process playbooks, and onboarding guides for new team members.
Build and maintain product analytics dashboards to track feature adoption, user engagement, operational KPIs, and platform health metrics across the Private Markets suite.
Coordinate UAT cycles — scheduling sessions, tracking feedback, consolidating tester input, and ensuring defect resolution is documented and closed prior to release.
Act as the connective tissue between product, engineering, QA, and business stakeholders — managing meeting logistics, distributing action items, and following up on open decisions.
Support the product team in vendor and third-party integration management: tracking onboarding milestones, maintaining integration documentation, and coordinating technical reviews.
Assist in the preparation of executive-level product updates, roadmap presentations, and quarterly business reviews — synthesizing inputs from multiple product workstreams into clear, well-structured communications.
Conduct structured research and analysis to support competitive intelligence efforts, product benchmarking, and market landscape assessments.
Monitor and triage incoming product feedback from internal stakeholders and client-facing teams; route requests to the appropriate PM and maintain a structured feedback log.
Contribute to process improvement initiatives — identifying operational bottlenecks, proposing workflow enhancements, and helping institutionalize best practices across the product team.
Support onboarding of new product team members by maintaining role guides, tooling access checklists, and orientation materials.

new_jobs.title: Power BI Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Power BI Data Analyst

Charlotte, NC (On-Site 4 Days/Week) • Full-Time Permanent •$70,000 – $100,000

About the Role

My client is looking for a sharp, proactive Data Analyst to help us modernize how we build and deliver reporting across the organization. This is not a passive, ticket-taking role — we need someone who can take ownership of our reporting landscape, engage directly with clients and business stakeholders to gather requirements, and drive a meaningful transition from legacy SSRS reports to a modern Power BI environment.
You will play a central role in our move toward Microsoft Fabric and a new data warehouse, helping shape the reporting layer that sits on top of it. If you are a strong SQL writer, a skilled report developer, and someone who communicates with confidence and clarity — this role is a great fit.

What You'll Do

Own report development end-to-end — taking requirements from business stakeholders and clients and delivering clean, accurate, and well-structured reporting solutions
Lead the conversion of existing SSRS reports into Power BI — assessing the current report library, prioritizing the migration roadmap, and executing the build
Interface directly with clients and internal stakeholders to gather business requirements, ask the right questions, and translate needs into reporting solutions
Bring structure and prescriptive standards to report development — moving the organization away from ad hoc, app-dev-driven reporting toward a governed, consistent approach
Support the organization's transition to Microsoft Fabric and a new data warehouse by building and maintaining the reporting layer on top of the new platform
Write complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate data across multiple sources in support of reporting and analysis needs
Maintain and support existing SSRS reports during the transition period, ensuring business continuity while the migration progresses
Proactively identify reporting gaps, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve how the business consumes information
Collaborate with data engineering and IT teams to understand data structures, pipelines, and warehouse design as it evolves
Document reporting standards, data definitions, and processes to support consistency and knowledge transfer across the team

Required Qualifications

Strong Power BI skills — experience building dashboards, reports, and data models that business users actually rely on
Experience in a data analyst or reporting analyst role with a strong focus on report development
Deep, hands-on experience with SSRS — you have built, maintained, and troubleshot complex SSRS reports in production environments
Strong SQL skills — you write complex queries comfortably and can work directly against databases to pull and validate data
Experience gathering business requirements directly from clients or non-technical stakeholders — you know how to ask the right questions and translate ambiguity into clear deliverables
Excellent communication skills — written and verbal; you are comfortable presenting to stakeholders, pushing back when needed, and explaining technical concepts in plain language
Proactive mindset — you do not wait to be told what to do; you identify problems, surface them early, and bring solutions
Ability to work on-site in Charlotte, NC four days per week

Nice to Have

Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric — exposure to the platform, its architecture, or its reporting capabilities is a strong plus
Experience working alongside a data warehouse build or migration — understanding how warehouse design impacts reporting
Experience establishing or improving reporting governance standards within an organization
DAX proficiency for advanced Power BI data modeling
Exposure to data pipeline concepts even if not directly building them

Who You Are

You are the kind of analyst who takes a messy spreadsheet request and hands back a structured, repeatable Power BI report — and then asks what else needs to be cleaned up. You have a strong technical foundation in SQL and reporting tools, but what sets you apart is your ability to communicate. You can sit across from a client, understand what they actually need (not just what they asked for), and deliver something that makes their job easier.
You are not someone who waits in a queue. You see the bigger picture, understand where the organization is headed, and proactively position your work to get us there faster. The SSRS-to-Power BI migration is a big lift — and you are someone who can own it with confidence.

Compensation & Work Arrangement

Salary: $70,000 – $100,000 based on experience
Location: Charlotte, NC — on-site 4 days per week, 1 day remote
Full-time permanent role with full benefits package

LMI is seeking a Data Analyst
to support the Deputy Assistant Secretary of War for Materiel Readiness (DASW, MR) office. The ideal candidate is a trusted advisor who can anticipate information needs, synthesize complex datasets, and build intuitive tools that enable senior leadership to make data-driven decisions efficiently.

As part of LMI’s high-performing team, you will leverage advanced data engineering and analytics capabilities to streamline front office operations and enhance situational awareness across acquisition, logistics, and procurement activities.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Engineering: Source, integrate, and analyze data from multiple DoD systems and enterprise platforms to develop insights supporting acquisition and sustainment decisions. Apply advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and automation to derive meaningful conclusions from large datasets. Possess the ability to work with and manipulate common data formats, including comma-delimited, text files, and JSON.
Dashboard Development: Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, and other DoD-authorized systems. Ensure dashboards are intuitive, accurate, and tailored to executive-level decision-making.
Process Optimization & Automation: Implement data-driven workflows and automated pipelines to support rapid analysis and reduce manual reporting burdens. Utilize technologies like Advana, Python and SQL, enable scalable and repeatable analytics solutions.

About The Role

Boston Scientific was recognized as a Glassdoor Best Place to Work in 2026, ranking No. 15 on the Top 100 list, reflecting the culture our employees experience every day.

The healthcare industry is experiencing rapid digital transformation, reshaping patient experiences and expectations—and creating a powerful opportunity to advance science through innovative, insights-driven digital solutions.

As the Senior Program Manager, AI Partnerships and Enablement, you will lead and accelerate MedTech AI initiatives by driving adoption of AI capabilities across programs, managing complex internal and external partner relationships, and enabling organization-wide AI transformation through capability building and change management.

This role demands strong program execution discipline, stakeholder influence, and the ability to translate AI opportunity into measurable business and clinical impact in a dynamic, matrixed environment.

Work Mode

At Boston Scientific, we value collaboration and synergy. This role follows a hybrid work model requiring employees to be in our local office at least three days per week.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Lead enterprise AI transformation programs: Own strategy, multi-year roadmap, governance, and execution for large, cross-collaborative AI programs spanning one or multiple functions; manage scope, milestones, dependencies, and outcomes across multiple workstreams.
Lead an enterprise AI Enablement Council: Build and program manage a cross-functional council that integrates technology enablement, workforce transformation, and workforce upskilling; establish shared priorities, roadmaps, decision rights, dependencies, and measures of success to ensure coordinated execution and adoption across the organization.
Drive measurable value realization: Define value cases and KPIs (e.g., cycle time reduction, quality improvements, productivity gains, cost avoidance, innovation throughput) and establish measurement and reporting mechanisms to track realization from delivery through sustained adoption.
Establish program operating cadence and governance: Support and run executive steering forums, portfolio prioritization, decision logs, and risk/issue management; ensure clear roles and accountability across all functions, divisions and regions.
Drive AI change enablement at scale: Design and execute adoption strategies across R&D and clinical/business workflows, including stakeholder mapping, communications, training, champion networks, feedback loops, and reinforcement plans to achieve sustained behavioral change toward AI-enabled decision-making.
Support AI capabilities and organizational literacy: Lead team that develops and delivers capability-building programs tailored to key personas (for example, R&D engineers/scientists, clinicians, product/program leaders), covering AI fundamentals, practical application patterns, data stewardship, and governance expectations.
Enable process improvement with AI: Identify, prioritize, and operationalize AI-enabled improvements to internal processes (e.g., value tracking, responsible AI process, metrics and scorecards); help redesign workflows for “AI-in-the-loop” execution with appropriate human review and controls.
Define scalable delivery playbooks and operating model: Create reusable intake/triage, feasibility, validation, deployment readiness, and monitoring templates; establish standards for how teams propose, evaluate, govern, and deploy AI solutions consistently.

new_jobs.description:
Build like a founder. Ship like Spartan.

Our clients are startups in a race: an MVP in 30 days, one demo away from a funding round. We’re looking for a Technical PM to run that race and keep every piece on track.

We don’t act like vendors. We embed. Our teams sit inside startups backed by YC, Pear VC, BlingCap, a16z, and Techstars, working beside founders and engineers from Stanford, MIT, Yale, Google, Amazon, and Uber. Together we ship those MVPs and scale the systems behind them to millions of users and billions of requests.

This isn’t a ticket-pushing PM role. You are the person a US founder calls when they need the truth about their product. You own scope, timeline, quality, and the client relationship. The engineers build. You make sure the right thing ships, on time, and the client knows exactly where things stand. And the Technical in the title is real: you read the architecture, question the estimates, and hold your own in an engineering discussion.

70% of our portfolio is LLM-powered. You’ll scope AI features, plan around model risk, and use Cursor and Claude yourself to write specs and plans faster.

Who Thrives At Spartan

Not every environment fits everyone, so here’s an honest picture of the teammate we’re looking for.

You’ll Thrive Here If

You own the outcome: scope, timeline, quality, and the relationship.
You’re technical enough that engineers can’t hand-wave you, and clear enough that founders never feel lost.
You can tell a founder no, with a reason and a plan.
You wear many hats without being asked: PM today, BA tomorrow, QA on release day.
You step into an at-risk project and bring it back to green.

Some weeks will stretch you. That’s the job. But you’ll never carry it alone. A critical client release or a hard founder conversation? The team is right there with you. We push each other hard because we care how far each of us can go. We win together. We lose together. Nobody gets left behind.

One last thing. We’re not filling seats. We’re looking for teammates for the battles ahead. If you read all this and something in you said yes, trust that feeling and apply. We respect people who back themselves. Every Spartan here started with that same yes.

What You’ll Do

Own delivery of client engagements end to end: scope, estimate, timeline, quality.
Be the daily voice to US startup founders. Run async standups, write sharp status updates, deliver bad news early and with a plan.
Turn vague founder ideas into PRDs and RFCs the team can ship in 30 days.
Scope AI features with clear eyes: what the model can do today, what needs a spike, and how to demo it honestly.
Plan AI work differently: prototype first, define evals early, budget for iteration.
Read the tech. Challenge estimates. Discuss architecture trade-offs with your Team Lead, then explain them to the founder in business language.
Track project health (Green / Yellow / Red), raise risks before they blow up, escalate with options, not problems.
Run the delivery process: sprints, code review SLAs, release plans, demos.
Support pre-sales: feasibility checks and estimates for new deals.
Wear whatever hat the project needs to win.

What We’re Looking For

Fluent English, spoken and written. You talk to US founders every day.
An engineering background. You’ve written production code, or worked close enough to it that a padded estimate can’t get past you.
3+ years running software delivery at an agency, consulting firm, or startup. That means you owned the projects, not just attended the standups.
You’ve told a client something they didn’t want to hear, and kept the contract.
You can persuade a non-technical founder to invest two sprints in tech debt, in their language, not jargon.
You work AI-native: Cursor, Claude, Codex. You use AI to plan, write, and move faster.
An owner’s mindset. You own outcomes, not tickets.

Nice to Have

Experience shipping LLM-powered products.
Experience with US or other Western clients.
Hands-on backend or frontend experience you can still use in a pinch.

Tools We Use

Notion

Slack
Linear
Jira
GitHub
Figma Cursor
Claude
Codex

Career Growth

Work directly with founders from YC, Stanford, MIT, Yale, Google, Amazon, Uber, and more.
Exposure to how AI products get scoped, built, and launched across many startup domains.
Transparent career path and mentorship from engineers who’ve taken 3 companies to IPO.
Every project feels like its own mini-startup.

Why Spartan

50+ MVPs launched, 3 IPOs, $100M+ raised by the startups we build with.
95% engineer retention. People stay because the work is worth staying for.
You take products zero to one. From a founder’s idea to a live launch in weeks. Most PMs get that chance once in a career. Here it’s the job.
Your work is visible. The product you run this month is in a founder’s investor demo next month.
No layers, no bureaucracy. You talk to the decision-maker directly, and decisions land in hours, not weeks.
Every project is a new market, a new team, a new problem. One year here teaches what three years elsewhere would.
You’ll never just take tickets. You’ll own problems, ship fast, and grow with the founders we partner with.

Benefits & Perks

💰 Competitive salary, 100% salary during probation
🏝 Unlimited PTO + public holidays
🩺 Premium healthcare insurance + annual health check
⚽ Sports clubs for every taste: football, badminton, billiards, pickleball

🏠 Hybrid working style, flexible hours
✈️ Annual company trip + monthly team parties
💻 MacBook provided
📜 Social insurance per Labor Law

Overview

This is a hybrid role with the expectation that time working will regularly take place inside and outside of a company office.

The FICC COO organization is seeking a Project Manager II to support business project management, execution tracking, governance, and stakeholder coordination across Foreign Exchange, Interest Rate Derivatives, and Commodities.

The role will work across Product Management, Middle Office, Risk, Regulatory, Operations, Technology, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and broader Markets partners to help drive delivery of key business, operational, control, and regulatory priorities.

This role is responsible for supporting assigned projects through the full project lifecycle, including planning, scope definition, milestone tracking, execution coordination, reporting, issue resolution, and delivery follow-through. The successful candidate will bring structure to complex cross-functional work, facilitate communication across teams, and help ensure project goals, timelines, risks, dependencies, and outcomes are clearly understood and actively managed.

Responsibilities

Project Execution and Lifecycle Management

Support the planning, execution, administration, and delivery of assigned business projects across FX, IRD, and Commodities.
Manage project activities across the project lifecycle, including planning, scope definition, requirements coordination, design support, implementation tracking, and delivery readiness.
Develop and maintain project plans, milestone trackers, action logs, issue logs, risk registers, and dependency trackers.
Track progress against key deliverables, timelines, milestones, budgetary considerations, and other relevant performance indicators.
Identify execution risks, delays, or dependencies and escalate issues to appropriate stakeholders in a timely manner.
Help ensure projects are delivered with clear objectives, defined ownership, appropriate governance, and measurable outcomes.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate project activities across internal teams and partner functions, including Product Management, Middle Office, Risk, Regulatory, Operations, Technology, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and broader Markets stakeholders.
Facilitate communication across functions to improve alignment, transparency, and process flow.
Convey clear expectations of project goals, deliverables, timelines, and accountabilities.
Support resolution of project issues by coordinating input, clarifying ownership, and driving follow-up actions.
Help keep project teams on track against agreed priorities, schedules, and commitments.
Support engagement with external vendors, consultants, or enterprise partners where applicable.

Governance, Reporting, and Management Information

Prepare project status updates, governance materials, meeting agendas, minutes, action trackers, and senior management reporting.
Implement and maintain methods for tracking project progress, risks, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and performance indicators.
Create reporting that provides clear visibility into project health, open issues, required decisions, and upcoming milestones.
Support recurring FICC COO governance forums, project working groups, business reviews, and stakeholder updates.
Maintain a consolidated view of key initiatives across FX, IRD, and Commodities to support transparency and prioritization.
Identify themes, gaps, and areas requiring management attention.

Business and Operating Model Support

Support cross-FICC initiatives that improve business processes, strengthen controls, enhance operating models, or address regulatory and risk-related priorities.
Help identify opportunities to standardize project governance, reporting, templates, and operating routines across asset classes.
Coordinate activities related to process improvement, workflow enhancement, control remediation, regulatory deliverables, and front-to-back operating model changes.
Assist with documentation of business requirements, current-state processes, future-state processes, decision points, and implementation plans.
Support project readiness activities, including stakeholder alignment, communication planning, training coordination, and adoption tracking.

Communications and Stakeholder Engagement

Draft and coordinate project communications, executive updates, briefing materials, talking points, and presentations.
Translate complex business, operational, risk, or regulatory topics into clear and concise messaging for varied audiences.
Maintain stakeholder lists, meeting cadences, and follow-up tracking across project workstreams.
Help ensure relevant teams are appropriately informed, engaged, and aligned on project objectives and delivery status.
Support communications across the FICC COO organization and with broader Markets and enterprise stakeholders.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree and 4 years of experience in Project Management OR High School Diploma or GED and 8 years of experience in Project Management.

Experience in project management, business project management, business management, COO, operations, risk, regulatory, product management, or a related financial services function.
Experience managing or supporting project lifecycle activities, including planning, scope definition, execution tracking, issue management, reporting, and delivery coordination.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, workstreams, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear materials for senior or cross-functional audiences.
Demonstrated ability to coordinate across multiple functions and drive follow-up on deliverables.
Ability to identify risks, dependencies, and open issues, and escalate appropriately.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality execution.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with Markets, FICC, FX, Interest Rate Derivatives, Commodities, or related capital markets businesses.
Experience working in a Markets COO, business management, middle office, operations, risk, regulatory change, or control environment.
Understanding of trade lifecycle, front-to-back operating models, product governance, risk and control frameworks, or regulatory remediation.
Experience creating project dashboards, executive updates, management reporting, project plans, and governance materials.
Experience working with technology, operations, risk, compliance, legal, finance, or external vendor partners.
Familiarity with Project Management Life Cycle disciplines; SDLC exposure helpful where projects include technology dependencies.
Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Power BI, Tableau, Visio, or other project/reporting platforms.

This individual will partner with cross-functional business teams to design the future-state operating model, define business readiness, and establish sustainable business-as-usual (BAU) processes that support a successful implementation.

Working closely with Transaction Management, Client Service Management, and other key stakeholders, this role will define Day One operational readiness, governance structures, escalation paths, and support models while documenting processes that ensure long-term operational success.

This is a 5-month contract with the potential for extension, located in Lake Mary, FL or New York, NY, or 100% Remote for candidates outside those office locations.

Operating Model Design: Develop the future-state operating model by defining business processes, governance structures, roles and responsibilities, and support models that enable successful implementation.
Business Readiness & Operational Planning: Establish Day One readiness by defining operational requirements, communication strategies, issue management processes, ownership models, and escalation procedures.
Process Analysis & BAU Development: Evaluate current-state processes, identify improvement opportunities, and develop scalable business-as-usual workflows, operational procedures, and support models.
Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with Transaction Management, Client Service Management, and other cross-functional teams to gather business requirements, facilitate discussions, and align the operating model with organizational needs.
Documentation & Governance: Produce process maps, operating procedures, governance documentation, RACI matrices, and other operational artifacts that support long-term business success.

5+ years of experience in operating model design, business transformation, business analysis, process improvement, or management consulting.
Experience designing or implementing future-state operating models within complex organizations.
Strong knowledge of process mapping, workflow design, governance models, and operational readiness planning.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and drive process improvements.
Excellent analytical, facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to translate complex business challenges into structured processes and actionable solutions.

Experience supporting digital transformation, enterprise modernization, or platform implementation initiatives.
Background in Financial Services, Banking, or Corporate Trust.
Experience developing Target Operating Models (TOM), service models, or operating frameworks.

Familiarity with Business Analyst methodologies, requirements gathering, and change management initiatives.

Note: This position is not eligible for Immigration Sponsorship at this time.

Role Summary

The Business Analyst serves as the bridge between utility stakeholders, engineering teams, and the delivery organization, ensuring that business needs are translated into clear, actionable requirements that drive the development of the Open Mains solution. The role is responsible for understanding current operational processes, identifying decision-making requirements, documenting functional and non-functional requirements, and ensuring delivered capabilities align with business objectives and field operations. The Business Analyst plays a critical role in defining how Open Mains insights will be consumed, validated, and operationalized by engineering, asset management, and field operations teams.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Elicitation & Analysis

Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, and working sessions to gather business, operational, and technical requirements.
Collaborate with engineering, asset management, reliability, and operations teams to understand existing Open Main investigation and remediation processes.
Document current-state and future-state workflows, business processes, and decision points.
Identify pain points, process inefficiencies, and opportunities for operational improvement.
Facilitate requirements prioritization and scope definition activities.

Business Process & Workflow Design

Map end-to-end workflows supporting:
Open Main detection
Engineering review and validation
Field investigation
Remediation planning
Feedback and model improvement
Document operational procedures and business rules that influence model outputs and decision-making.
Define user journeys and interaction flows for engineering and operational users.
Ensure proposed workflows align with existing utility processes and governance requirements.
Support design of human-in-the-loop review and validation processes.

User Stories & Functional Requirements

Develop and maintain detailed business requirements, user stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria.
Define functional requirements for:
Open Main candidate review workflows
Risk prioritization dashboards
Investigation workspaces
Evidence packages and supporting analytics
Feedback and validation mechanisms
Define non-functional requirements including usability, performance, security, auditability, and reporting needs.
Maintain requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

Data & Analytics Requirements

Collaborate with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to define business requirements for data and analytics solutions.
Document requirements related to:
AMI interval data
Network topology and connectivity
Asset and equipment information
Historical defects and work orders
Operational and engineering datasets
Support development of business definitions, KPIs, and performance measures.
Ensure analytical outputs align with engineering decision-making needs.

Stakeholder Engagement

Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams.
Facilitate consensus across engineering, operations, data, and technology stakeholders.
Support executive and operational working sessions.
Communicate requirements, priorities, assumptions, and constraints clearly to delivery teams.
Assist in managing stakeholder expectations and addressing requirement changes.

Testing & Validation Support

Support development of test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities with business stakeholders.
Validate delivered functionality against documented requirements.
Facilitate defect triage and business validation sessions.
Ensure business sign-off for key deliverables and releases.

Change Management & Adoption

Support creation of user training materials and process documentation.
Assist with operational readiness and deployment activities.
Gather and document user feedback to support continuous improvement.
Help drive adoption of Open Mains capabilities within engineering and operational teams.

Qualifications

5+ years of Business Analysis experience on technology, analytics, or operational transformation initiatives.
Demonstrated experience gathering and documenting complex business requirements.
Strong process mapping, workflow analysis, and facilitation skills.
Experience working within Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Experience

Electric utility operations, engineering, reliability, or asset management programs.
Predictive analytics, AI/ML, or advanced analytics initiatives.
Grid modernization, asset health, or condition-based maintenance programs.
Human-in-the-loop decision support solutions.
Experience working with engineering, operations, and field organizations.

Key Deliverables

Business Requirements Document (BRD)
Functional Requirements Specification
User Stories & Acceptance Criteria
Current-State and Future-State Process Maps
User Journey Maps
Business Rules Documentation
Data & KPI Requirements
Traceability Matrix
UAT Test Scenarios & Business Validation Plans
Change Impact Assessment
Operational Readiness Documentation

Open Mains-Specific Focus Areas

The Business Analyst is expected to develop a deep understanding of:
Open Main investigation and validation workflows.
Engineering review and prioritization processes.
How engineers evaluate evidence supporting potential Open Main conditions.
Work package creation and field investigation processes.
Model feedback loops used to improve precision and recall.
Performance measures used to evaluate operational effectiveness of the solution.
Integration points between Open Mains analytics, engineering workflows, and work management processes.

About The Company

Verisk is a leading data analytics and risk assessment company dedicated to providing innovative solutions across various industries, including insurance, energy, and financial services. With a strong commitment to leveraging advanced data technologies, Verisk helps organizations make informed decisions, manage risks effectively, and improve operational efficiencies. The company prides itself on its collaborative culture, global presence, and focus on delivering value-driven insights to its clients. Verisk’s extensive suite of products and services is designed to meet the evolving needs of its diverse customer base, ensuring they stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented professional to join our team in a role focused on WCIO compliance reporting for Data Collection Organizations (DCO). This position involves working closely with internal teams, external clients, and regulatory bodies to ensure compliance with WCPOLS, WCSTAT, and related standards. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of workers' compensation data reporting, particularly within the context of ISO's wcPrism reporting services, and will play a pivotal role in supporting client implementations, system enhancements, and ongoing maintenance activities.

This role requires proactive problem-solving skills, the ability to analyze complex data sets, and effective communication across organizational levels. The successful candidate will contribute to continuous process improvements, support client onboarding, and ensure that all reporting activities align with regulatory requirements and industry standards. The position offers an excellent opportunity to work in a dynamic environment where your expertise will directly impact client satisfaction and operational excellence.

Qualifications

College degree, preferably in Business Administration, Data Management, or a related field.
3-4 years of experience in workers' compensation data reporting or related fields.
Thorough knowledge of WCIO standards and compliance requirements.
Proficiency in data reporting, processing, and analysis.
Strong research and diagnostic skills for issue resolution.
Excellent customer service and project management capabilities.
Exceptional troubleshooting and analytical skills.
Outstanding verbal and written communication abilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; experience with Microsoft Project or similar tools is preferred.
Willingness to travel as required to meet business needs.

Responsibilities

Manage daily client activities and support operations related to workers' compensation data reporting, utilizing an interactive ticketing system for tracking and resolution.
Assist in managing the product backlog and contribute to the development of the product roadmap, ensuring alignment with client needs and regulatory changes.
Participate in regular and ad hoc client meetings to gather requirements, provide updates, and address concerns.
Provide expert support to staff and clients regarding WCIO standards and specific DCO requirements for WCPOLS, WCSTAT, WCDCI, WCMED, and WCIND products.
Monitor DCO circular announcements and communicate necessary specifications for wcPrism system updates to ensure compliance with evolving requirements.
Collaborate closely with clients and the product engineering team to deliver timely solutions, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.
Support internal ISO staff with specialized knowledge and assistance on relevant projects and issues.
Keep divisional management informed of customer issues, progress during integration, and potential red flags through regular updates.
Continuously review and improve internal processes and procedures to meet client needs and industry standards.
Conduct research, diagnostics, and issue resolution activities to address client data reporting challenges effectively.

Benefits

Verisk offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and professional growth of its employees. This includes competitive salary packages, health insurance plans, retirement savings options, paid time off, and opportunities for ongoing training and development. The company fosters a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages innovation and recognizes individual contributions. Employees also benefit from flexible work arrangements and a supportive corporate culture committed to work-life balance.

Equal Opportunity

Verisk is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating an environment where all employees are valued, respected, and provided with equal opportunities for growth and advancement. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these factors.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager - Pursuit Management
new_jobs.description:
Requirements

Description & Requirements

Maximus is hiring a Pursuit Project Manager to drive the successful execution of complex business development opportunities and RFP responses. This role is responsible for leading cross-functional pursuit teams, developing and managing integrated project plans, tracking milestones and risks, facilitating decision-making, and ensuring on-time delivery of critical pursuit activities. The ideal candidate is a strong project manager who thrives in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments, excels at coordinating stakeholders across multiple functions, and leverages AI-enabled tools and automation to improve visibility, efficiency, and execution. This position also provides opportunities to mentor junior team members and contribute to continuous improvement of pursuit management and governance practices.

Why Maximus?

🔄 Work/Life Balance Support - Flexibility tailored to your needs!
💰 Competitive Compensation -Bonuses based on performance included!
🛡️ Comprehensive Insurance Coverage - Choose from various plans, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, and partially funded HSA. Additionally, enjoy Life insurance benefits and discounts on Auto, Home, Renter's, and Pet insurance.
🌟 Future Planning - Prepare for retirement with our 401K Retirement Savings plan and Company Matching.
🏝️ Unlimited Time Off Package - Enjoy UTO, Holidays, and extended sick leave, along with Short and Long Term Disability coverage.
🌱 Holistic Wellness Support - Access resources for physical, emotional, and financial wellness through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
🏆 Recognition Platform - Acknowledge and appreciate outstanding employee contributions.
📚 Tuition Reimbursement - Invest in your ongoing education and development.
🎁 Employee Perks and Discounts - Additional benefits and discounts exclusively for employees.
🌟 Maximus Wellness Program and Resources - Access a range of wellness programs and resources tailored to your needs.
📚 Professional Development Opportunities-Participate in training programs, workshops, and conferences.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Lead pursuit teams to execute required actions and deliverables aligned to opportunity timelines and RFP requirements.
Create and manage integrated project plans, milestone schedules, dependencies, decision checkpoints, and readiness calendars.
Track action ownership, due dates, completion status, risks, issues, open decisions, and leadership follow-ups.
Manage risk, issue, and action-item logs; escalate decisions and barriers with clear options, impacts, and recommended next steps.
Coordinate and negotiate across operations, IT, pricing, HR, finance, proposal, sales, and other pursuit resources to maintain schedule adherence.
Use approved AI-enabled tools and automation practices to streamline recurring status reporting, meeting-note synthesis, action-item extraction, and risk visibility.
Mentor junior staff; review trackers, status updates, and governance materials for clarity, completeness, and follow-through.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in relevant field of study and 7+ years of relevant professional experience required, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Program Requirements:

Specialized experience needed: hands-on management of complex pursuits, proposals, implementations, or other deadline-driven projects with multiple workstreams, dependencies, governance routines, and executive visibility.
Candidates should be advanced users of integrated project plans, milestone schedules, readiness trackers, RAID logs, action registers, decision logs, and executive status reporting.
Must have strong cross-functional coordination experience across operations, IT, pricing, HR, finance, sales, proposal, SMEs, and leadership stakeholders.
Must communicate clearly, escalate early, and use approved AI-enabled tools to streamline notes, action tracking, reporting, and risk visibility.

This position is fully remote and will require a home office.

Home office requirements:

Reliable high-speed internet service

Minimum 20 Mpbs download speeds/50 Mpbs for shared internet connectivity

Minimum 5 Mpbs upload speeds

EEO Statement

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information and other legally protected characteristics.

Pay Transparency

Maximus compensation is based on various factors including but not limited to job location, a candidate's education, training, experience, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value analysis including seniority and merit systems, as well as internal pay alignment. Annual salary is just one component of Maximus's total compensation package. Other rewards may include short- and long-term incentives as well as program-specific awards. Additionally, Maximus provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and paid time off. Compensation ranges may differ based on contract value but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience. An applicant's salary history will not be used in determining compensation. Maximus will comply with regulatory minimum wage rates and exempt salary thresholds in all instances.

Accommodations

Maximus provides reasonable accommodations to individuals requiring assistance during any phase of the employment process due to a disability, medical condition, or physical or mental impairment. If you require assistance at any stage of the employment process—including accessing job postings, completing assessments, or participating in interviews,—please contact People Operations at applicantaccom@maximus.com

new_jobs.description:
Salary Range:
$160.00 per hour

Who We Are

TechSource, a Salas O'Brien company, is a nationally recognized engineering and scientific company specializing in the management and technical delivery of large-scale nuclear and high-technology projects with numerous federal agencies, helping to advance missions of national importance for government programs, national laboratories, national security facilities, nuclear operations, and complex projects nationwide. We provide direct access to hundreds of experts and industry leaders in the nuclear sciences, non-proliferation technologies, accelerator physics, and systems engineering arenas with offices in Washington DC, SC, TX, TN, and NM. Our outstanding technical service has earned the company a client retention rate of over 95 percent. As part of Salas O'Brien, we work to attract and retain the best talent because the best talent delivers the best results for our clients.

Job Summary

As a part-time Senior Program Manager, you will provide commissioning and start-up expertise on oversight reviews on an as-needed basis for our Department of Energy Project Management (DOE-PM) clients. You may also provide nuclear safety management support. This is remote work with occasional travel.

Responsibilities

Provide support to commissioning and start-up activities for oversight reviews for DOE-PM.
Advise and assist decision makers on nuclear safety considerations.

Qualifications And Experience

US citizenship.
20 or more years of DOE/NNSA commissioning, start-up, and manufacturing experience including nuclear safety.
Excellent skills in interpersonal communications, task management, and both verbal and written communication.

Compensation & Benefits

The expected base salary range for this role is $160.00 per hour. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Equal Opportunity Employment Statement

TechSource provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/provincial, or local laws. TechSource will accommodate the disability-related needs of applicants as required by law.

Third-Party Agency Notice

TechSource does not accept unsolicited resumes from external recruiters or agencies. We only work with approved partners engaged directly by our Talent Acquisition team for specific searches. Unsolicited submissions will not be eligible for placement fees.
